svg.text: FRAME · view on the open back
blind pocket 13 wide for the driver
board's own USB-C; the top wall
stays solid, 1.5 of skin outboard of
inside the 1.707 limit for a sharp
pocket, so no corner relief is
proud of the PCB, so the seat is
ribbon relief 3 out x 40 along the
other, 3 past the glass back face. A
slot rather than a local pocket
because the ribbon runs ALONG this
edge; it also sets the frame width
corner relief R1.4 at all four GLASS
pocket corners, so the glass's sharp
THE MODULE, AND THE RIBBON ROUTE
glass 76 x 90, sharp corners. Dead border
3 on three sides, 9.4 on the ribbon side.
Pocket margin 1.5 on the width, 1.5 on the height.
Seen from the rear, the ribbon leaves
the thick-bezel edge - a LONG-AXIS edge
- folds back behind the glass, turns 90
deg to run ALONG that edge, then 90 deg
back out to the header. That run is why
the relief is a 40 slot, not a pocket.
STLs export flat-face-down and MIRRORED IN X (print_mirror = true)
